diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says SCL, datasheet reading says INT
diffs.evidence: SparkFun SEN-14045 Eagle board MAX30105_Breakout.brd: header J2 (package 1X05) nets are pad 1 = signal SCL, pad 2 = SDA, pad 3 = 5V, pad 4 = GND, pad 5 = !INT; top silkscreen labels along the header read SCL (y=6.35), SDA (8.89), 5V (11.43), GND (13.97), !INT (16.51). The second reading lists the same five pins in exactly reversed order (INT, GND, 5V, SDA, SCL), i.e. it numbered from the opposite end; the model matches the board's pad numbering.
